name: second-brain-privacy
description: Audit the vault for material that should not be in it: credentials, other people's private information, confidential work, and anything the user would not want synced or backed up. Use this skill when the user asks about privacy, is about to share or sync the vault, has just imported chat history or meeting notes, or asks what is sensitive in their notes. Do NOT use to delete anything on your own, or as a substitute for the publishing check.
